followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain three distinct balloon-related restriction phases with a reopened interval between the first and later episodes. Salcininkai suspension and Medininkai exemptions differ; November20 actual evidence is strongest at Medininkai. Vehicle-only and pre-existing entry rules persist. Retain R1 October21–22 to October22 bounds0–1days, correcting its reopening flag to Yes; R2 October26–30 ends at legal transition with complete flag0; D1 October30–November20 remains21calendar days to scoped actual return. No spans are summed into uninterrupted all-traffic closure. Contraband smuggling and public/aviation safety are explicit attributed official justifications. No additional rationale is inferred from political commentary. Four primary government bodies and substantive BNS/LRT indexed onsite reporting were read. November19 permission is prospective; November20 observation supplies the operational endpoint. Retain all three unlocated phases with null coordinates. Actual passage at Medininkai does not authorize surveyed coordinates or an observed reopening footprint at every post.
